text:
maria_cs: FYI customer reported their free-trial credits expired yesterday and they never got promo credits applied. They say they applied code PROMO-APR but still 0 credits. Wants extension or clarification on policy.
sam_engineer: can you paste the support ticket id and the account id? we should check if code was applied server-side or client error.
maria_cs: ticket #4521, account-id acct_0a9f3. Quote from customer: 'I entered PROMO-APR during signup on 4/25 but the dashboard shows expired trial and no promo. Can you reinstate credits?'
alex_ops: quick policy note — default is no retroactive free-trial extensions, but we do one-time exceptions for good-faith promo code misapplication if it's within 30 days of expiration. escalate to billing for manual grant.
billing-bot: Account acct_0a9f3 — trial_credits: 0 USD, last_credit_grant: 1717250000, trial_expires: 1719800000, promo_codes: [PROMO-APR: applied=false]
karen_support: thanks — looks like promo flag never set. maria, can you confirm whether customer entered code at checkout or after? that affects UX repro steps.
maria_cs: customer says they entered it during signup. they included a screenshot of the confirmation page (link: https://redwood.internal/sup/4521/screenshot1). not trusting the screenshot alone — we need server logs.
sam_engineer: ok i'll pull the signup events. repro steps I need: account-id, exact code string, timestamp of their signup, and user agent if available.
maria_cs: adding those to the ticket: acct_0a9f3, code PROMO-APR, signup time 1719735600, UA: Mozilla/5.0 (they attached header).
sam_engineer: looked at event logs — promo validation call returned 404 at the time of signup for that user (race condition with promo service deploy). ticket shows 'promo-service 502' around 1719735602. here's a snippet:
```
POST /promo/validate {code: "PROMO-APR", acct: "acct_0a9f3"} -> 502 Bad Gateway
```
This explains why promo wasn't set.
alex_ops: great find. since this was our service outage, we should make the customer whole. propose manual grant: $100 credits + extend trial expiration by 30 days from now.
jordan_bizops: sounds reasonable for PLG motion. confirm accounting won't flag this as policy abuse.
karen_support: i'll run the manual grant now. internal CLI:
```
redwood grant-credits --account acct_0a9f3 --amount 100 --expires 171? (30 days)
```
I'll set expires to 1722480000 (30 days from now). updating ticket.
billing-bot: Action: grant-credits succeeded. account acct_0a9f3 now has 100 USD credits, expires: 1722480000. transaction id: tx_9c8a.
maria_cs: confirmed — emailed customer that we granted $100 credits and extended trial 30 days. customer replied: 'thank you so much! this fixes our integration testing.' :relieved:
alex_ops: please add internal note to ticket: root cause = promo-service deploy race causing 502; 1-off customer remediation granted. open follow-up with eng to add retry/queue for promo validation.
sam_engineer: filed follow-up issue ENG-1427 for promo validation retry logic.
karen_support: closing ticket after 48h if no issues. marking as resolved. :thumbsup:
maria_cs: thanks everyone, nice example of billing + eng coordination.
